nl: 供应商结算：查询有供应商（下拉数据来自 /api/suppliers 接口）、结算周期；表格展示供应商、结算周期、应结金额、状态；表格上方左侧「新增结算单」、右侧「批量导出」；支持新增、编辑、删除；应结金额保留两位小数；新增、编辑、删除按钮需要权限码 settle:add、settle:edit、settle:remove；查询表单标签宽度 90px。
nlEn: Supplier settlement: query by supplier (the supplier dropdown data comes from the /api/suppliers endpoint) and settlement cycle; the table shows supplier, settlement cycle, payable amount, and status; above the table "New Settlement" is on the left and "Batch Export" on the right; supports add, edit, and delete; the payable amount keeps two decimal places; the add, edit, and delete buttons require permission codes settle:add, settle:edit, settle:remove; the query form label width is 90px.
notes: 五维覆盖：apiParams(供应商下拉走接口) + formLayout(labelWidth) + tableBtns(左/右) + permissions + extPoints(formatter 两位小数)。formatter 承载字段 amount 必须 inTable:true（schema 模式才会产 formatter warning）。
